Right Parenthesis Extension Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Right Parenthesis Extension because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+239F, which you can use as ⎟ in HTML, \239F in CSS, or type with Alt+9119 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Right Parenthesis Extension is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+239F is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Right Parenthesis Extension has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ⎟ or the hex escape ⎟.

How to type right parenthesis extension on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 9 1 1 9 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 9119.
  4. Release Alt. The Right Parenthesis Extension character (⎟) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type right parenthesis extension on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Right Parenthesis Extension. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Right Parenthesis Extension" and click the character to insert it.

How to use right parenthesis extension in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\239F"; ()
  • Python: \u239F or chr(0x239F)
  • JavaScript: \u239F or String.fromCodePoint(0x239F)
  • JSON: "\u239F"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ⎟?

No legacy Alt code exists for Right Parenthesis Extension because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+239F in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ⎟ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ⎟, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+9119 not work?

Alt+9119 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Right Parenthesis Extension?

The Unicode codepoint for Right Parenthesis Extension is U+239F. You can use this value in HTML as ⎟, in CSS as \239F, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ⎟ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+239F, then click it.
